title: IntentLock V2 Payment Authorization Handoff
description: Signed purchase authorization verified by the nested Mongoose payment service before PayPal order creation. It does not authorize capture.

authorization_token.description: Three compact segments: base64url(protected header).base64url(JSON claims).base64url(Ed25519 signature); signature input is the ASCII protected-header segment, a dot, and the claims segment.

public_key.description: Flask Ed25519 public key; the Mongoose service must compare it with its independently configured trust anchor.

intent_hash.description: SHA-512 digest from the Python engine's normalized intent serialization for audit. Payment interoperability uses purchase_hash and snapshot_hash instead.

snapshot_hash.description: SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 canonical immutable CheckoutSnapshot payload.

amount_minor.description: Authorized amount as a canonical decimal integer string; must not exceed the Python safe-integer range.

purchase_hash.description: SHA-512 of RFC 8785 canonical JSON for exactly user_id, intent_id, intent_version, proposal_id, snapshot_id, snapshot_hash, amount_minor, currency, minor_unit_exponent, merchant_id, and paypal_merchant_id.

nonce.description: Cryptographically random 128-bit nonce. The Mongoose service enforces single-use with a durable unique index.

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp; expires no more than 60 seconds after issued_at.
